//: mirbadllm-hostd seed config. Root-owned (0644) at /etc/mirbadllm/hostd.json; the controller cannot change it. On first start these entries seed the admin-managed whitelist in /var/lib/mirbadllm-hostd/whitelist.json (root, 0600); entries added here later are merged into it once. After that the Services page adds/removes units (admin password required). Units matching the compiled-in deny list (sshd, systemd-*, dbus, docker, networking, NVIDIA driver daemons...) or /etc/mirbadllm/hostd-deny.json can never be managed. discoverUsers: whose --user units are discovered. Restart the agent after editing: sudo systemctl restart mirbadllm-hostd

services.name: comfyui
services.description: Image and video generation. Holds about 40 GiB of GPU memory while a workflow's models are loaded.

services.name: ollama
services.description: Embeddings for OpenViking and models for Hermes. Stopping it breaks OpenViking's embeddings until it is started again.

services.name: lmstudio-server
services.description: LM Studio's llmster backend, an OpenAI-compatible API on port 1234.

services.name: dgx-dashboard
services.risk: The DGX Dashboard is NVIDIA's console for this box. Stopping it takes the dashboard offline until someone starts it again from a shell.

services.name: dgx-dashboard-admin
services.description: The privileged backend of the DGX Dashboard (updates, system settings).
services.risk: The DGX Dashboard's admin backend runs system updates and settings. Stopping it mid-update can leave the box half-updated.

services.name: rustdesk
services.risk: RustDesk is the remote desktop into this box. Stopping it ends every remote desktop session, possibly including yours.

services.name: nvidia-dgx-telemetry
services.description: NVIDIA's DGX health and telemetry collector.
services.risk: NVIDIA DGX telemetry reports this box's health. Stopping it leaves NVIDIA's health reporting blind until it is started again.
